answer:790d8d10-35c4-4e47-82c8-8f20505f1: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:a3ee1356-3856-4e01-a1f7-1f65318c7: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
